title: New datasource dialog defaults to managed, which cannot sync an existing database's tables, and does not say so
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order, verbatim: 「你发现的问题都立卡，安全问题总专用的安全密卡通道，需要进一步分析的进一步测试，还是没有把握的用决策卡。」 (2026-11-05). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Setup on `main` `04f36b63f8`, with a test app and a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** The page says 连接外部数据库，并将其中的表同步为对象. Someone following that with the defaults ends up with a datasource that has no sync button and no explanation.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev for `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx:190`.

**Duplicates.** Searched `datasource schemaMode default managed external dialog` (12 hits). #24837 and #24772, both closed, are about Sync and the default datasource's status. None covers this default.

## Measured

- The dialog's 结构模式 defaults to 托管（表结构由 ObjectStack 管理）.
- A datasource saved in that mode shows only 测试. 同步对象 appears only on the external one. `GET …/remote-tables` answers 400 with an English message citing ADR-0015.
- In my test the managed datasource left the source table unchanged, with the same tables and columns.
- With 外部 selected, the flow works: sync offers the table, reads work and writes are refused.

Not measured: what managed mode does to the source database when an object is later bound to it. Whether that can alter a customer's tables is what makes the default matter, so the dev should settle it first.

## Expected

- The modes are explained in business words where they are chosen, including which one to pick to read an existing database.
- The default fits the page's stated purpose. I suggest 外部, unless the dev finds a reason that a new datasource needs managed. If so, say it in the PR.
- A managed datasource says why it has no sync, rather than just having no button.
- Driver form labels such as `Filename` and `Auto-migrate schema` read in the console's language.
